summary: Arm Holdings plc furnished a Form 6-K on September 18, 2026, submitting its U.K. Annual Report and Accounts for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, signed by Chief Accounting Officer Laura Bartels. The 6-K is a routine foreign-private-issuer report used to furnish the annual report and consolidated financial statements, not a special-situation event. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock are disclosed. The filing corresponds to a U.S. annual-report equivalent (Form 20-F-style disclosure). Watch for future 6-Ks disclosing strategic or transactional activity, but nothing deal-related is present here.
